## Summary

[Partial] Identify Mass Air Flow sensor and locate two Camshaft Position sensors plus one Crankshaft Position sensor. [t338]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. [Partial] Identify the Mass Air Flow sensor located on the intake tube near the air filter.
2. [Partial] Locate the two Camshaft Position sensors situated on opposite sides of the engine backside near the firewall.
3. Find the Crankshaft Position sensor positioned lower down on the passenger side, accessible behind the wheel.

_Procedure reported by [t338]._
